sloka: न मर्षयति चात्मानं सम्भावयति नात्मना।अदर्शयित्वा शूरास्तु कर्म कुर्वन्ति दुष्करम् ।। ६.६५.४ ।।
transliteration: na marṣayati cātmānaṁ sambhāvayati nātmanā।adarśayitvā śūrāstu karma kurvanti duṣkaram ।। 6.65.4 ।।

translations.english: "Warriors do not tolerate even when glorified. They never praise themselves. They accomplish difficult deeds without displaying them."
